Inside Porsche’s $100M Brand Engine: A Day at PEC Atlanta

In the automotive industry, experiential marketing has become the ultimate benchmark for luxury brand building. What began at Porsche's Leipzig factory as a "window into the workshop" has expanded into 10 global destinations designed to immerse enthusiasts, buyers, and executives directly into the Porsche lifestyle. Forbes Contributor Scotty Reiss travels to the Porsche Experience Center (PEC) in Atlanta—located directly adjacent to Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport—for a full day exploring how this flagship facility functions as both an adrenaline playground and a brilliant brand engine.

The track program centers on 1-on-1 instruction across the newly expanded West Track, where professional drive coaches guide visitors through technical handling modules.
